frozen_candidate_root_contribution: ر ا ف names a tender, gentle inward disposition toward a personal object — a felt inclination to treat persons softly and to spare them from pain/harshness. It surfaces only as the faʿūl bearer-attribute (raʾūf) and the faʿlah quality-noun (raʾfah); it is a property of the heart (God's, the Prophet's, or believers'), object-directed (marked by bi- + human object or placed fī qulūb), not an act, gift, or guaranteed outcome, and evaluatively neutral (praised in God/Prophet, to be suppressed when it obstructs a mandated ḥadd).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: ر ا ف names a tender, gentle inward disposition toward a personal object — a felt inclination to treat persons softly and to spare them from pain/harshness. It surfaces only as the faʿūl bearer-attribute (raʾūf) and the faʿlah quality-noun (raʾfah); it is a property of the heart (God's, the Prophet's, or believers'), object-directed (marked by bi- + human object or placed fī qulūb), not an act, gift, or guaranteed outcome, and evaluatively neutral (praised in God/Prophet, to be suppressed when it obstructs a mandated ḥadd).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 13 occurrences the root ر ا ف carries one idea: a soft, tender-hearted concern aimed at people. It appears as raʾūf, the one who bears that tenderness (of God 10x, of the Messenger once), and as raʾfah, the tenderness itself — placed in the hearts of Jesus's followers (57:27) or the pity that would stay the flogging hand (24:2). The quality is always directed at persons (bi-l-nās, bi-l-ʿibād, bi-kum, bi-him, bi-l-muʾminīn) and 9:128 effectively defines it: a heart pained by others' suffering and eager for their welfare. It is not the same as leniency-in-outcome (God is raʾūf while warning of Himself in 3:30 and while seizing in 16:47), and it is not always to be acted on (24:2 forbids letting it deflect God's penalty). The honest limit: in 9 of 13 tokens raʾūf/raʾfah is welded to the r-ḥ-m field (raʾūf raḥīm / raʾfatan wa-raḥmatan), and the Quran never internally states how the two differ, so a distinct semantic load beyond 'near-synonym of mercy' is only sharply shown in a minority of verses.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT an act, gift, bestowed thing, or outcome (never 'sent down' or 'given'; distinct from co-present act-terms ghufrān 59:10, tawba 9:117, faḍl/raḥmah 24:20). NOT leniency-in-outcome or non-punishment (coexists with divine warning 3:30 and seizing 16:47). NOT a virtue to be maximized or always correct (must be suppressed fī dīn Allāh, 24:2). NOT self-directed and NOT toward non-persons/creation-at-large (object is always human). NOT reverence/awe (rahbāniyyah stands as a separate root in the same verse 57:27). NOT demonstrably distinct-in-content from r-ḥ-m on internal evidence — that distinction is UNRESOLVED.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 24:2:12:1 — 'وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ': the sole human-subject, negated/prohibited token, positioned as an obstacle to a divine command. This is a polarity/behavioral inversion, not a semantic one: the content (a tender pull to spare the flogged from prescribed pain) is exactly the nucleus, only the evaluation is reversed. It therefore disproves any 'raʾfa = always divine / always positive / always a virtue' framing while confirming the field-level nucleus and establishing evaluative neutrality as a firm boundary.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: raʾfa is a formulaic near-synonym / intensive doublet-partner of r-ḥ-m with no independent semantic content — a faʿūl intensive deployed in the frozen raʾūf raḥīm cadence for reinforcement. Support: near-inseparable pairing (10/13), identical bi- object-marking, identical sentence-final epithet slot, and the total absence of any internal contrast statement. It is defeated only for the minority: 57:27 names raʾfatan wa-raḥmatan as two distinct things in one heart (pure synonymy would be redundant), and 2:207/3:30/24:2 (3/13) show raʾūf/raʾfah standing alone without a r-ḥ-m partner, plus the invariant raʾfa-before-raḥma ordering. Because the nuance separating them is never internally specified, this competitor cannot be refuted Quran-internally, which caps the grade below STRONG.

STRONG is refused for two contract-material reasons: (1) formulaic dependence — 9 of 11 raʾūf tokens are the frozen raʾūf raḥīm doublet (plus raʾfatan wa-raḥmatan), so high frequency adds tokens, not discriminating contexts, and the distinctive load is sharply attested in only ~3/13 (24:2, 2:207, 3:30); (2) the distinctiveness of raʾfa from its constant neighbour r-ḥ-m is not established from internal evidence and is reported as an honest UNRESOLVED sub-finding. clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 2:207:10:1 — raʾūf bi-l-ʿibād where there is no harm to avert, so the sense is pure tender regard/appreciation; this resists any narrowest 'harm-aversion/sparing' specialization and forces the core up to 'tender solicitous compassion.' 3:30 shows raʾfa coexists with self-warning, defeating a leniency-in-outcome reading. These 2 standalone tokens are the principal evidence that raʾfa is not a mere appendage to raḥma.

clusters.classification_rationale: Distinct faʿlah surface (ra>ofap-) but bridges tightly to the faʿūl bearer: one who is raʾūf bi-X has raʾfah toward an object, and 24:2's raʾfah is likewise object-specific (bi-himā). 24:2 inverts evaluation (a disposition to be suppressed) without changing content, so the cluster stays content-CONSISTENT.

reconciliation.rationale: The three lenses agree the content is identical to the nucleus (tender inclination to spare an object from prescribed pain); only the evaluation is context-reversed. candidate_root_contribution: ر ا ف names a tender, gentle inward disposition toward a personal object — a felt inclination to treat persons softly and to spare them from pain/harshness. It surfaces only as the faʿūl bearer-attribute (raʾūf) and the faʿlah quality-noun (raʾfah); it is a property of the heart (God's, the Prophet's, or believers'), object-directed (marked by bi- + human object or placed fī qulūb), not an act, gift, or guaranteed outcome, and evaluatively neutral (praised in God/Prophet, to be suppressed when it obstructs a mandated ḥadd).

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13/13 confirmed occurrences read from real Tanzil verse_text with QAC morphology: raʾūf (faʿūl) 11x (16:47, 16:7, 22:65, 24:20, 2:143, 2:207, 3:30, 57:9, 59:10, 9:117, 9:128), raʾfah (faʿlah) 2x (24:2, 57:27); objects marked bi- + human or placed fī qulūb throughout.
layer_attribution.derivation: Two derivatives of one root: the faʿūl intensive bearer-attribute raʾūf and the faʿlah quality-noun raʾfah. No verbal forms occur. The two bridge tightly — the one who is raʾūf bi-X has raʾfah toward an object — supporting a single DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY rather than separate classes.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: raʾūf functions as an attribute/epithet (of Allah 10x, of the Messenger 1x); raʾfah as an abstract quality-noun that can be instilled (57:27) or can 'seize' a person (24:2). The QAC N vs ADJ tag on 9:128 is a POS artifact, not a semantic class boundary.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual/narrative meanings (protection from hardship in 16:7/22:65, relenting in 9:117, the ḥadd context in 24:2, self-warning in 3:30) illuminate but are NOT elevated to the root claim; they are treated as frames in which the invariant disposition surfaces, not as the root's content.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary RESISTANT reading of 24:2 was reconciled to CONSISTENT: identical nucleus content with reversed evaluation (evaluative/behavioral inversion, not a semantic seam), yielding the evaluative-neutrality boundary rather than a class split.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No occurrence remains finally resistant to the nucleus. The one genuinely unresolved item is the distinctiveness of rAf from its constant neighbour r-ḥ-m, which is not establishable Quran-internally (formulaic doublet in 9/13 tokens, no internal contrast statement) and is reported as an honest null, capping the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_cases.reason: Only human-subject, negated, obstacle-to-divine-command token; nominal raʾfah edging toward lexicalized 'leniency.' Kills any 'always divine/always positive/always a virtue' claim and, together with the doublet-formulaic dependence, caps strength at MODERATE.

evidence_basis.statement: 24:2:12:1 — 'وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ': the sole human-subject, negated/prohibited token, positioned as an obstacle to a divine command. This is a polarity/behavioral inversion, not a semantic one: the content (a tender pull to spare the flogged from prescribed pain) is exactly the nucleus, only the evaluation is reversed. It therefore disproves any 'raʾfa = always divine / always positive / always a virtue' framing while confirming the field-level nucleus and establishing evaluative neutrality as a firm boundary.

hard_cases.reason: raʾūf standing alone without a raḥīm partner, with no harm to avert, resisting the narrowest harm-aversion specialization and forcing the core up to 'tender solicitous compassion'; also key evidence that raʾfa is not a mere doublet appendage.

evidence_basis.statement: 2:207:10:1 — raʾūf bi-l-ʿibād where there is no harm to avert, so the sense is pure tender regard/appreciation; this resists any narrowest 'harm-aversion/sparing' specialization and forces the core up to 'tender solicitous compassion.'

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence is finally RESISTANT under the refined nucleus, so there is no RESISTANT_SEAM. But two genuine, evidence-grounded hard cases exist: 24:2 (an adversarial evaluative-inversion boundary and lexicalizing nominal sub-class that caps strength) and 2:207 (a structural atypicality that standalone-breaks the doublet and re-scopes the core). Each statement is mirrored in strongest_counterexample (24:2) and in cluster c2's supporting note (2:207).

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence or contrast in which raʾūf/raʾfah either (a) carries a semantic content demonstrably distinct from a resistant sub-sense that cannot be bridged to 'tender disposition toward persons,' or (b) is definitively shown to be a mere phonological/rhetorical variant of r-ḥ-m with no separable content — either of which would move the field from a single bridged DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY toward UNRESOLVED or a REJECTED nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 3 non-doublet tokens (2:207:10:1, 3:30:25:1, 24:2:12:1) and the raʾfatan-wa-raḥmatan pairing at 57:27:17:1, tested against the 9 frozen raʾūf raḥīm / doublet slots for any minimal pair that isolates or collapses raʾfa's content relative to r-ḥ-m.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each occurrence's verse_text and qac morphology; check whether the object-marking (bi- + human), the fī-qulūb placement, and the raʾfa-before-raḥma ordering hold, and whether any verse states or entails a content difference from r-ḥ-m rather than merely co-listing the two.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude imported lexicon/tafsir 'more acute/tender than mercy' glosses (source-policy forbidden); do not count the frozen doublet's high frequency as independent confirmations; separate evaluative polarity (24:2) from semantic content; treat the QAC N/ADJ tag on 9:128 as a POS artifact, not a semantic split.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If (a) is found, split the field and downgrade to UNRESOLVED / UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY; if (b) is found, reject the independent nucleus (research_state REJECTED) and record rAf as a non-distinct doublet-partner of r-ḥ-m; if neither is found, the current MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE bridged nucleus stands with distinctiveness-from-rḥm as an explicit UNRESOLVED sub-finding.

reopen_conditions: If a raʾūf/raʾfah occurrence is read where the object is non-human or the disposition is self-directed (contradicting the invariant bi- + human / fī-qulūb object-directedness attested at 2:207, 3:30, 22:65, 2:143, 57:9, 9:117, 9:128, 24:2, 57:27), reopen the object-directedness boundary.

If any verse is shown to state or entail a content contrast between raʾfa and raḥma (beyond the mere co-listing at 57:27 and the frozen raʾūf raḥīm order), reopen the currently-UNRESOLVED distinctiveness-from-rḥm sub-finding toward STRONG.

If the raʾfah nominal at 24:2 is judged a truly lexicalized 'leniency' sense not bridgeable to the faʿūl bearer-attribute, reopen the single-DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY partition toward a multi-class/UNRESOLVED result.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The field-level nucleus survives adversarial pressure with zero failing occurrences (24:2 confirms it; 2:207 only re-scopes it). But a genuine adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with distinctiveness_ok=true is NOT achievable: raʾfa's distinct content from its constant neighbour r-ḥ-m is not establishable Quran-internally (9/13 tokens are the frozen doublet, no internal contrast statement). Because distinctiveness_ok=false, the run cannot be marked PASSED; because no occurrence actually refutes the nucleus, it is not FAILED. Recorded as NOT_RUN with the resistance/limitation logged.
